mitigating_circumstances: Old age, health ailments, responsibility of looking after unmarried daughter, past meritorious service, prolonged trial
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 354 IPC, sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for six months and fine of Rs. 1,000/-
neutral_facts: The accused, a senior police officer, was involved in an incident where he molested two minor girls. The girls were members of a tennis association and were practicing at a court. One of the girls, who was a minor, was taken to the accused's office where he used criminal force on her, attempting to embrace her while she resisted. The incident was witnessed by another girl, who later informed her family and authorities. The case was investigated, and the accused was initially convicted and sentenced. The accused appealed, arguing the delay in reporting the incident and the reliability of the evidence. The Supreme Court upheld the conviction but reduced the sentence due to the accused's advanced age and health conditions.
